turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: I actually got some guitar practice in yesterday evening, which was a nice way to unwind. I haven't done much rock climbing this week though, just trying to keep my legs fresh for the run.

turns.text: That makes total sense, tapering your activity before the big race is smart. How are you feeling physically? Ready for the weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Today is a full rest day, thank goodness. I'll probably just do some light stretching later tonight. Sam and I might watch a movie.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sounds like a perfect Friday night plan. Relaxing and resting up is exactly what you need.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Exactly. Well, I should probably get back to my logistics work now, but I'll talk to you later!

turns.speaker: assistant
